name: Joplin I-44 Weigh Station (Eastbound), MM ~3
note: Location from OpenStreetMap. Westbound side is tagged CLOSED in OSM.
hot: Carriers report very strict enforcement. Drivewyze lists Joplin among the highest-volume stations in Missouri. Two Flock ALPR cameras at the station (33 m and 168 m).

name: Anthony Port of Entry (I-10 Westbound), MM ~159
note: Location read from Mapbox satellite imagery (scale house and inspection loop on the westbound side). Not tagged in OpenStreetMap.
hot: New Mexico's primary inspection station (NMDOT). Open 24/7. Third-party FMCSA aggregate (truckcodex): ~10.9% out-of-service rate.

name: North Platte I-80 Weigh Station (Westbound)
note: Nebraska State Patrol Carrier Enforcement. Location from OpenStreetMap, confirmed on satellite imagery.
hot: One of NSP's four I-80 scales. NSP also runs portable-scale sweeps on routes trucks use to avoid scales (Buffalo Co., Aug 2025: 212 violations, 19 out-of-service).
